review.description: Adopt original request choices, blocking/nonblocking state, one-time responses and bounded approvals in S1-S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Answer durable claiming, validateAnswer/permissionSubset and AttentionDialog/Elicitation. Claimed delivery failure is not described as an automatic retry or guaranteed exactly-once delivery.
review.tests: Question, concurrent-answer, nonblocking/approval, schema/permission and recovery tests have concrete assertions; assembled UI exercises question answering. Real native verification and every host dialog variant remain open.
